source.name: SportsLogos.Net News – 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

note: League-wide sleeve patch since 2023; shown as a league deal (clubId null) because Apple pays MLS, not the club.
